content:
presales-lina: Merlin Bank POC hitting sharp TTFT tails after ~25-40s of steady traffic. p50 ~380ms but p95 jumps to 1.9-2.6s. We also see bursts of 429s with body saying `shared_warmup_limit`. They have Dedicated (6xA100) using model=redwood/aurora-13b-8k. Need a quick triage please.

merlin-sse: Confirming. 429 payload: {"error":"shared_warmup_limit","retry_after_ms":1000}. They set `shared_warmup=true` to save tokens.

dev-raj: Can you paste one of the request payloads and any runtime snippets around a spike window? Also curious about batch window and kv_cache metrics.

merlin-sse: Sample (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer ****
Body: {"input":"<dialog>", "max_tokens":600, "shared_warmup":true}
```
Runtime excerpts: 
```
2026-05-10T09:21:08Z INFO req_id=tx1 qps=58 batch_window_ms=110 kv_cache_hit_rate=0.19 warmup_lock_wait_ms=95
2026-05-10T09:21:09Z WARN req_id=tx2 token_emit_tail_ms=2100 warmup_queue_wait_ms=1100
2026-05-10T09:21:10Z ERROR req_id=tx3 warmup_lock_expired=true
```

infra-oliver: Two signals: KV hit rate degrades under sustained QPS (cache churn / eviction) leading to more token work; second, the shared_warmup locking serializes work and warmup_queue caps trigger 429s. Batch_window ~110ms is high which amplifies tail.

presales-lina: Merlin tried `shared_warmup=false` and p95 dropped to ~760ms, but their token estimates went up ~14% which they don't love. They want to keep cost savings if possible.

dev-raj: Short-term ask: have them try reducing batching delay: set `batch.max_delay_ms=18` and `batch.max_tokens=300`. Also try `warmup_adaptive=false` to see if warmup heuristics are causing excess locking.

security-bob: Merlin's security reviewers also flagged the warmup lock change; need a short note explaining the fix and no data leaves the customer cluster. I'll draft that once we have a plan.

infra-oliver: Long-term fixes we can test: (A) increase warmup lock partitions (8 -> 24) to reduce contention, (B) add adaptive bypass: if kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.32 then skip shared warmup for short windows, (C) introduce a short traffic warmup that pre-populates top prefixes for 3-6s on ramp.

dev-raj: I can prototype (A) + (B) and run a canary. We'll also add telemetry to emit `warmup_bypass_reason` and `kv_hit_snapshot` for post-mortem.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: job=60123 component=runtime-warmup-fix target=dedicated-canary-7
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: job=60123 status=running

merlin-sse: Canary receiving ~12% of traffic now. Monitoring p50/p95, warmup 429s, and avg tokens. Will report back in 20m.

acct-amy: Important: Merlin is price-sensitive. If the fix increases tokens, we need a precise delta before rolling to prod or asking them to toggle settings. I'll coordinate with AE.

presales-lina: Sending interim guidance to Merlin: (1) for soak tests, set `shared_warmup=false`; (2) reduce `batch.max_delay_ms` to 18ms; (3) we will run a canary for lock partitioning + adaptive bypass and follow up on cost numbers.

merlin-sse: Canary update (23m): p50=400ms p95=880ms, warmup 429s dropped from ~15/min to 2/min, avg tokens per request ~+1.2% (within noise). Looks promising.

infra-oliver: If metrics hold for an extended window we'll promote and ship a runtime flag so customers can opt into the warmup partitions. We'll also add a short docs blurb for security reviewers about lock semantics.

presales-lina: Great. I'll loop in AE and security. Closing this swarm unless new regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
